source.purpose: Frozen evaluation only; no external fitting, calibration, hyperparameter selection or outcome-dependent filtering
source.publication: Aggregate evaluation results and source/provenance hashes only; per-row features, labels, prompts, programs and token records stay in the ignored local cache
source.overlap_check: Report exact normalized-prompt hash overlap if original source prompts are locally available; identity namespaces and prompt hashes do not rule out semantic overlap or model-training contamination
source.aggregation: Average frozen source-fold predictions per answer at the primary source budget, then evaluate once across the 161 external task clusters; no selection among source folds using external outcomes

publication: Aggregate results only; no external row-level records published
overlap_audit: Task identities use distinct namespaces; exact source-prompt overlap not checked because original source prompts are not cached; semantic overlap and pretraining contamination remain unverified
interval_scope: Descriptive task bootstrap for 161 tasks conditional on the frozen five-pipeline ensemble
